Synopsis:
Florrick is with her Flaming Fist troops in Haven. As you approach, they are furiously trying to put a plan together to rescue Ravengard. The curse is one thing, but Ketheric is invincible. They can't just storm the place. And even if they could, they would execute the prisoners if the alarm was raised - including the Grand Duke.Florrick turns to you, incredibly grateful that we have made it so far. She implores you to work with Jaheira for her rescue efforts, but tells you your priority is clear: Duke Ravengard. He must be returned to the city - it will not survive his absence.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_Florrick.json: Florrick is with her Flaming Fist troops in Haven, franticly trying to plan a way to get Duke Ravengard back from Moonrise Towers — they know the cult and Ketheric make a direct assault suicidal, and any alarm could mean the prisoners (including the Grand Duke) are executed. She’s grateful you made it this far, asks you to coordinate rescue efforts with Jaheira, and insists the top priority is returning Ravengard to the city. Off‑screen, Moonrise Towers are held by Absolute cultists: sadistic guards who mind‑meld to test intruders, can detain or humiliate prisoners, and will react strongly if the player has already interfered with tower rituals or attacked cult leaders. Florrick also notices a conspicuous change in you (her lines call attention to your eye), so your appearance or recent bargains may affect how both the Flaming Fist and tower sentries treat you.
- CAMP_Ravengard.json: Default Ravengard dialogue. Depending on the path, Ravengard may urge you to save the city, and if Wyll is in party, will offer the quest to go to the Wyrmway. Wyll's endgame state is detremined here: He may become a Duke, the Blade of Avernus, or remain the Blade of Frontiers
- LOW_FlorrickFight_DialogHook.json: Confrontation with Florrick if Ravengard died. Wyll is not present.
- LOW_FlorrickFightFallback_WithoutWyll.json: Confrontation with Eltan noble if Ravengard died and Florrick is dead or still in prison. Wyll is not with party in this version
- PLA_Tavern_DeadFF1_Dead.json: The Cult of the Absolute has ransacked the inn at Waukeen's Rest and kidnapped Duke Stelmane of Baldur's Gate. The player arrives after the carnage, finding corpses strewn about. The player casts 'Speak with Dead' on one of these corpses - a member of the Flaming Fist who was sworn to protect the Duke. She was among the final Fists left standing. She was killed guarding the Duke.
